title: How Final Whistle Plays
description: Four pitch domains, one floodlit battlefield — assemble a squad, outmaneuver rivals in turn-based duels, and climb the seasonal ladder with clean Attack and steady Defense.

pillars.title: Pitch Tactics
pillars.description: Trade lines on a living board where timing, lane pressure, and burst windows matter more than raw stats. Win the turn before you win the match.

pillars.title: Squad Collecting
pillars.description: Pull cards from Striker's End, Engine Room, The Box, and Back Line — then stitch keywords, curves, and finishers into a list that rewards precision.

pillars.title: Seasonal Ladder
pillars.description: Climb seasonal tiers, learn from losses, and refine your lines. The summit rewards managers who adapt without losing their shape.
